_doc: Realistic caller personas (caller-realism.mjs, run.sh --realistic / CALLER_REALISM / a scenario's '#@caller <id>'). Per scripted turn: filler = chance of an 'um,'/'uh,' after a pause and at the start; restart = chance of repeating the words before a pause ('I was, I was'); pause = chance of a mid-turn pause (a second one at pause squared), pauseMs its range, inserted mid-thought, never after a sentence end; trailOff = chance a line ending '.' trails off '...'; rate = speaking-rate ratio range (Cartesia <speed>, say [[rate]]). minWords: shorter lines get only the rate. voice: the Cartesia caller voice when CALLER_VOICE is unset. Lines are rendered from a seed of scenario, turn and persona, so a rerun says the same thing.

everyday.about: A cooperative caller who talks like a person, not a script: some ums, a thinking pause now and then, rate varies line to line.

flat-deflector.about: Short, flat, plays it down ('it's fine, whatever'). Red team 2026-10-21 eh-answers and flat-heavy-news: Ferni argued the news was heavy (#2333).

trailing-thinker.about: Thinks out loud: long pauses mid-sentence, restarts, trails off. Call review 2026-10-20: 'remind me next time I schedule...' was cut off and a reminder set for a time never given (#2289).

walk-away.about: Distracted: talks over Ferni, changes topic, steps away mid-call. Call review 2026-10-22: Maya repeated replies the caller had cut off (#2422).
